name: Tikuv
tagline: Clothes cut to your measurements, and garments we bring back to life
niche: Atelier: bespoke tailoring, alterations and clothing repair

listing.description: A website for an atelier, tailor or sewing workshop. A pattern that draws itself on the first screen, a tape measure, services as pattern pieces and figures as tags on a thread.

seo.title: Tikuv — atelier in Tashkent: tailoring and repairs
seo.description: Bespoke suits, dresses and shirts cut to measure, fitting alterations, repairs and zip replacement. Fittings with the tailor, same-day express repairs.
seo.answer: Tikuv is an atelier at 12 Abdulla Qodiriy Street in Tashkent, open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 to 20:00. A made-to-measure men’s suit starts at 3,500,000 UZS and takes 3–4 weeks, trouser alterations from 60,000 UZS, zip replacement from 50,000 UZS. Express repairs are done in a day; book a measuring session on Telegram or by phone.

sections.title: Cut for you
sections.subtitle: Suits, dresses and shirts made to your measurements, alterations of ready-to-wear and careful repairs. We take 30 measurements, hold two fittings and don’t hand anything over until it fits.

sections.label: Atelier
sections.title: A workshop that fits the garment, not the customer
sections.text: Five tailors and a cutter experienced in menswear and womenswear. We work with your fabric or help you choose ours: wool, linen, cotton, silk. One tailor leads each garment from measurements to the last button, so you never have to explain twice.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: What we make and mend
sections.intro: Prices cover the tailor’s work; fabric is extra. We confirm the exact cost after the fitting.

items.title: Men’s suit
items.text: Two- or three-piece to measure, two fittings, hand-finished lapels.

items.title: Made-to-order dress
items.text: Evening, cocktail or everyday — from sketch to final fitting.

items.title: Made-to-measure shirt
items.text: Choose the collar, cuffs and cloth; we keep your pattern for next time.

items.title: Fitting alterations
items.text: Take in, shorten, rework a jacket at the shoulders or waist.

items.title: Repairs & zips
items.text: Zip replacement, darning, patches, lining restoration.

items.title: Wedding outfit
items.text: Dress alterations, the groom’s suit and outfits for the parents.

sections.label: How we work
sections.title: From measurements to a finished garment

items.title: Measurements & fabric
items.text: We take 30 measurements, discuss the cut and choose the cloth.

items.title: Pattern
items.text: Our cutter drafts a pattern for your body, not a size.

items.title: First fitting
items.text: The garment is basted: we adjust the fit and length.

items.title: Final fitting
items.text: We check every detail and steam it before handover.

items.quote: For the first time a suit doesn’t pull at the shoulders. Two fittings, and it fits as if I was born in it.
items.author: Jasur

items.quote: They remade my mother’s dress for me and kept the embroidery. I cried at the fitting.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: They replaced the zip on my jacket in two hours while I had lunch nearby.
items.author: Artyom

items.q: How long does a suit take?
items.a: Three to four weeks with two fittings. If you need it by a date, tell us when booking and we’ll plan the fittings around it.

items.q: Can I bring my own fabric?
items.a: Yes. We’ll look at it during measuring and tell you whether there’s enough for the chosen cut.
Zip replacements, trouser hems and small repairs are done in a day, often within a couple of hours.
For tailoring, 50% after the first meeting and the rest on collection. Repairs are paid on pickup.

items.q: Do you tailor for men and women?
items.a: Yes, and for teenagers too, including school uniforms and prom suits.

sections.label: Book
sections.title: Come in for a measuring
sections.text: Measuring and consultation are free and take about 40 minutes. Message us on Telegram and we’ll suggest a time.
